source: 787 Magic Mirror Divination’s Answers
target: 787 Responsa Divinationis Speculi Magici

source: When Great Shark Jörg and his men arrived at the dock, the spot where the Newins had been moored was now empty, with only the gentle ripples of blue water moving softly in the light fog.
target: Cum Magne Squalus Jörg et sodales eius ad molam pervenerunt, locus quo Newins ancora alligata fuerant iam vacuum apparuit, solisque lenibus undarum caerulearum in levis nebula fluctuantibus.

source: At that moment, Jörg and the other pirates stood frozen, as if they were staring at a surreal painting beyond their imagination.
target: Illo momento, Jörg et ceteri piratae immobiliter stabant, quasi ad picturam insolitam ultra fines imaginationis suae intuentes.

source: Soon, a deep panic gripped them.
target: Mox pavor profundus eos premit.

source: The Admiral fled on the Newins.
target: Admiralis in Newins confugit.

source: What do we do now?
target: Quid nunc facimus?

source: If that unknown adventurer couldn’t kill the Admiral and let him escape, will he turn his attention to us for revenge?
target: Si ille ignotus adventor admiralem nec occidit nec eum effugere sinit, num suam iram in nos ad vindictam transferet?

source: He used illusions to deal with us; he must have really come to hunt the Admiral…
target: Illusiones ad nos oppugnandos usus est; certe ad admiralem venandum venit.

source: Their thoughts raced, and Great Shark Jörg and his men turned and ran, fleeing the dock area.
target: Cogitationes eorum festinanter cursaverunt, et Magne Squalus Jörg cum sodalibus conversi sunt et cucurrerunt, regionem molae relinquentes.

source: They needed to find the Newins’ contacts in Banamo Port, relying on their local knowledge to find a secret place to hide and then contact Admiral Deep Sea to decide their next steps.
target: Eis opus erat invenire contactus Newins in Portu Banamo, inniti scientia locali ut locum secretum ad abscondendum reperirent, deinde cum Admirali Profundi Maris colloqui ut sequentia decreterent.

source: Inside the captain’s cabin of the Newins.
target: Intra conclave capitanei Newins.

source: Howl Constantine, having donned his translucent octopus mask again, stared at the nearly lightless, swaying seawater outside the thick glass window, feeling his internal and external wounds gradually healing with the help of medicinal potions.
target: Howl Constantine, larvam octopodis translucidam iterum indutus, intuebatur aquam maritim fere lucis carentem et fluctuantem extra crassam fenestram vitream, dum vulnera interiora atque exteriora paulatim medicamentis potionibus sanantur.

source: He couldn’t help but recall his recent encounter.
target: Non potuit quin recentem congressionem recoleretur.

source: Though it was extremely painful, it brought him an unprecedented pleasure, leaving his soul almost completely blank.
target: Etsi valde dolorosum erat, ei induxit inauditam voluptatem, relinquens animam fere omnino vacuam.

source: The joy it gave him far surpassed that of the women brought to the ship, making him want to experience it again despite his strong will.
target: Gaudium, quod illud ei dedit, longe superabat modum mulierum in navem delatorum, ita ut eum ad iterum experiri concitaret, non obstante valida voluntate sua.

source: Phew… Howl Constantine exhaled, grateful that he had activated the Newins’ defense system in time.
target: Heu… Howl Constantine suspiravit, gratus quod tempore systema defensionis Newins activaverat.

source: Otherwise, under the influence of that extreme pleasure, he would have been easily killed in the next second.
target: Aliter, sub influxu illius extremae voluptatis, facile occisus fuisset in secundo proximo.

source: He believed the assassins had felt the Newins become extremely dangerous, leading them to retreat and flee the alchemical ship without pursuing him further.
target: Credebat sicarios sensitisse Newins fieri periculosissimos, quod eos ad retrahendum et ad effugiendum navem alchemicam impulit, sine eum ulterius insequi.

source: He did not regret not activating the defense system earlier; being caught off guard, he had no time to do so.
target: Non illi pœnitet quod systema defensionis non prius activaverit; captus enim improviso, tempus nullum habuit ad id faciendum.

source: What puzzled Howl Constantine now was when the seed of pleasure had been planted in him, causing an explosive reaction upon seeing the true face and figure of that Demoness.
target: Quod Howl Constantine nunc mirabatur fuit, cum semen voluptatis in eo plantatum esset, quod explosivam reactionem excitavit, cum veram faciem atque staturam illae daemonissae intuebatur.

source: He muttered to himself, Is that why the male assassin never attacked?
target: Murmuravit sibi: “Num propter hoc sicarius masculinus numquam aggressus est?”

source: Not that he didn’t want to, but he couldn’t, not until the pleasure seed had fully rooted in my soul?
target: Non quod noluerit, sed non potuit, nisi semen voluptatis in anima mea plene radicatum fuerit?

source: What are their true intentions beyond assassinating me?
target: Quae sunt verae consilia eorum ultra me interficere?

source: Are they after the secrets of the Newins and the Lost Newins?
target: Num arcana Newins atque Newins Perditos quaerunt?

source: Lacking the necessary clues, Admiral Deep Sea found it hard to make a decisive judgment and could only suppress his emotions for now, planning to contact his subordinates in Banamo Port once his body and soul had fully recovered to check if they had noticed anything unusual.
target: Carens indicibus necessariis, Admiralis Profundi Maris iudicium certum facere difficile invenit et solum affectus suos reprimere potuit, disponens subditos suos in Portu Banamo contingere, postquam corpus atque anima plene restituta essent, ut perscrutarent num quid insolitum animadvertissent.

source: Instinctively, he reviewed the recent events, trying to find investigative details.
target: Instinctu, eventus recentes recensuit, quaerens indicia investigatoria.

source: But removing the true intentions of the assassins made the whole affair seem like a deliberate setup by two Demonesses and their companions to give him an ultimate pleasure, with the near-death experience being a normal part of it.
target: Sed abscondendo veras intentiones sicariorum totum negotium videbatur quasi consilium praeordinatum a duabus daemonissis et sociis eorum ad ultimam voluptatem tribuendam, cum experientia prope mortem pars ordinaria eius esset.

source: In this world, many have died from pleasure without being attacked.
target: In hoc mundo, multi ex voluptate mortui sunt, sine aggressione.

source: Reflecting on this, Howl Constantine noticed a shiny gold Louis d’or at the cabin door.
target: Cogitans de hoc, Howl Constantine aureum nummum “Louis d’or” nitidum ad ianuam cubiculorum animadvertit.

source: It was left by the two Demonesses.
target: Ab duabus daemonissis relinquitus erat.

source: Staring at the water at the doorstep and the gold coin, which had clearly been treated to prevent tracking, Howl Constantine suddenly had a ridiculous thought and fell into an indescribable silence.
target: Intuens aquam ad limen et nummum aureum, qui manifeste tractatus erat ut vestigia prohiberet, Howl Constantine subito cogitationem ridiculam habuit et in silentium ineffabile cecidit.

source: In the motel room rented by Lumian and company in Banamo Port.
target: In cubiculo deversorii a Lumiano et collegis in Portu Banamo conducto.

source: Jenna quickly removed the Scotch Broom-like Decency brooch and submerged it in the aluminum military flask Lumian had given her.
target: Jenna celeriter extraxit fibulam “Decency”, quae similem “Scotch Broom” erat, et eam in lagenula militari ex aluminio, quam Lumian ei dederat, immergit.

source: Almost simultaneously, Jenna felt the eyes of Lumian, Franca, and Anthony change significantly.
target: Paene simul, Jenna sensit oculos Lumiani, Francae, et Anthonii signanter mutatos esse.

source: Their gazes now held undisguised disgust, aversion, and malice.
target: Aspectus eorum nunc aperte fastidium, aversionem, et malitiam ostenderunt.

source: Jenna had felt malice from some people in the bars and dance halls of Trier’s Rue Pasteur, but it was often mixed with desire and longing, unlike the pure hatred and loathing now directed at her.
target: Jenna sensit malitiam ab quibusdam in popinis ac in aulis saltationis Trierensis in via Pasteur, sed ea saepe cum cupiditate et desiderio miscebatur, contraria vero purae odii et fastigii nunc in eam directae.

source: Of course, Jenna also noticed a certain amount of desire in Franca’s disgust and aversion, as if she wanted to satisfy herself by domineering over Jenna.
target: Certe, Jenna etiam animadvertit aliquod desiderii quanti in Francae repulsione et aversione, quasi illa per dominationem super Jenna se ipsam satiari velle.

source: Lumian, though his expression remained relatively normal, had a change in his eyes, reflecting an Ascetic’s endurance.
target: Lumian, quamquam vultus eius relative ordinaris mansit, in oculis autem eius mutatio facta est, quae tolerantiam asceticam repraesentabat.

source: He nodded at Jenna and said, “The Decency brooch’s negative effect has taken hold. Go to the next room for an hour.”
target: Ille Jennae annuit et dixit: “Effectus negativus fibulae Decency dominatus est; i ad proximum cubiculum per horam.”

source: “I know.” Jenna glanced at Lumian, recalling past events.
target: “Scio.” inquit Jenna, ad Lumian aspiciens, praeterita recolens.

source: Back then, she had been tasked with protecting Lumian under the negative effect of the Decency brooch, and she had felt the urge to beat him up.
target: Tunc munus eius erat Luminum sub effectu negativo fibulae Decency tueri, atque impetum eum verberandi sensisse.

source: She regretted not taking the chance to draw piles of dogsh*t on his face.
target: Paenitebat quod non cepisset occasionem ut in facie eius acervos stercoris canum depingeret.

source: Recalling these memories, Jenna smiled slightly, left the room, and went to wait for the negative effect to wear off in the next room.
target: Reminiscens haec, Jenna leviter subridens cubiculum reliquit et processit ad exspectandum effectu negativo in proximo cubiculo evanescendo.

source: “Phew, the Decency brooch’s negative effect is really strong…” Franca commented sincerely.
target: “Heu, effectus negativus fibulae Decency vere validus est…” inquit Franca sincere.

source: Lumian gave her a sidelong glance and laughed.
target: Lumian ei aspectum obliquum dedit et risit.

source: “I think your hatred and disgust weren’t pure enough.”
target: “Puto odium et fastidium vestrum non satis purum fuisse.”

source: Franca immediately felt embarrassed, awkwardly smiling as she said, “Sometimes, hatred and disgust can also spark desire. Just ask Anthony!”
target: Franca statim erubuit, leviter risu ornata, dicens: “Interdum, odium et fastidium etiam desiderium excitare possunt. Tantum interroga Anthony!”

source: Before Lumian could turn to him, Anthony spoke up, “It’s true.
target: Antequam Lumian ad eum converteret, Anthony dixit: “Verum est.

source: The human brain and soul are complex.
target: Cerebrum et anima hominis sunt complexa.

source: Different people might develop the same desire from different stimuli.
target: Diversi homines eundem desiderium ex diversis stimulis evolvere possunt.

source: “Some get pleasure from pain, others from jealousy, breaking taboos, being scolded or tortured, or sharing with others, gaining their affection.
target: Quidam voluptatem ex dolore capiunt, alii ex invidia, alii ex violatione praeceptorum, alii ex reprehensione aut tormento, aut ex communicando cum aliis atque eorum affectionem adipiscendo.

source: The possibilities are endless.”
target: Possibilitates sunt infinitæ.

source: “In simple terms, the world is full of perverts?” Lumian mocked Franca.
target: “In terminis simplicibus, mundus est plenus depravatorum?” inquit Lumian, Francam irridens.

source: Franca didn’t take the bait, her expression growing serious as she frowned slightly.
target: Franca non incidit in insidias; vultus eius serio factus est, leviter fronens.

source: Once free from the Decency brooch’s negative effect, she recalled the scene she had witnessed earlier.
target: Postquam liberata est ab effectu negativo fibulae Decency, scaenam priorem, quam antea conspexerat, recoluit.

source: After some thought, she said, “Do you think Admiral Deep Sea’s real appearance resembles Harrison from Resurrection Island?”
target: Postquam paulum cogitavit, inquit: “Putasne veram speciem Admiralis Profundi Maris Harrisonem ex Insula Resurrectionis similem esse?”

source: Lumian recalled and said, “You mean they both have noticeable Eastern features?”
target: Lumian recoluit et dixit: “Scilicet uterque notabilia elementa orientalia habet?”

source: He had seen Franca’s drawing of Harrison.
target: Picturam de Harrison, quam Franca effinxerat, vidit.

source: “Yes, but more like a mix of someone like Harrison and an Intisian or person from the North Continent,” Franca said thoughtfully.
target: “Ita, sed magis ut compositum ex aliquo simili Harrison et Intisiano aut homine ex Continente Septentrionali,” Franca cogitabunda inquit.

source: Because Anthony was present, she didn’t mention the transmigration matter, instead steering towards Resurrection Island.
target: Quia Anthony praesens erat, rem de transmigratione non attinuit, sed potius versus Insulam Resurrectionis inclinavit.

source: With a nod, Lumian replied, “Draw Howl Constantine’s portrait, and we’ll write to the Tarot Club Major Arcana card holders.”
target: Cum annuens, Lumian respondit: “Pinge imaginem Howl Constantine, et scribemus ad possessoribus chartarum Tarot Club Major Arcana.”

source: “No need to ask Madam Judgment or Madam Magican yet; I’ll try with Magic Mirror Divination first,” Franca responded immediately.
target: “Non est opus adhuc petere Dominam Iudicium aut Dominam Magicanam; primum conabor Divinationem Speculi Magici,” Franca statim respondit.

source: She began preparing the ritual in the room, sketching Howl Constantine’s features from memory.
target: Ritum in cubiculo parare coepit, lineamenta Howl Constantine ex memoria delineans.

source: This included an appearance similar to Resurrection Island residents, slightly pointed ears, dark blue near-black thick hair, and the tentacle-like dark veins on his hands when holding the obsidian trident.
target: Hoc includebat aspectum similem incolis Insulae Resurrectionis, aures paulo acutatas, capillos densos coloris caerulei fuscati, et venae obscurae, quasi tentacula, in manibus eius, dum tridente obsidiano tenebat.

source: Some details Franca hadn’t noticed during the fight were now retrieved from her memory through the ritual.
target: Nonnulla singularia, quae Franca in certamine non animadvertit, nunc per ritum ex memoria restituta sunt.

source: Lumian examined the portrait for a moment and said, “It does have an Eastern style.”
target: Lumian picturam per momentum consideravit et dixit: “Habent quidem stilum orientalem.”

source: Franca nodded, then busied herself with the Magic Mirror Divination.
target: Franca annuit, tum se occupavit Divinatione Speculi Magici.

source: Soon, the mirror on the desk turned dark, with faint sounds of water echoing within.
target: Mox speculum in mensa obscurum factum est, cum sonis aquae leviter resonantibus intus.

source: Franca picked up the portrait of Admiral Deep Sea and asked the target of the Magic Mirror Divination, “What does this appearance signify?”
target: Franca picturam Admiralis Profundi Maris arripuit et ab obiecto Divinationis Speculi Magici interrogavit: “Quid hanc speciem significat?”

source: She didn’t directly ask about Howl Constantine’s origins, fearing it was beyond the Magic Mirror Divination’s knowledge.
target: Non directe de originibus Howl Constantine quaesivit, metuens id extra scientiam Divinationis Speculi Magici esse.

source: A hoarse, elderly voice emerged from the mirror: “This is an elf.”
target: Vox rauca et senilis ex speculo exortus est: “Hic est elfus.”

source: An elf?
target: Elfus?

source: Lumian’s temples throbbed.
target: Tempora Lumiani pulsabant.

source: This was a legendary Beyonder race!
target: Haec erat gens Beyonder legendaris!

source: Previously, Lumian had only known of elves as a mythical race from ancient times, living on the Sonia Sea’s Sonia Island.
target: Priore tempore, Lumian tantum de elfis novit ut gens mythica ex temporibus antiquis, in Insula Soniae Maris Soniae degentibus.

source: He learned they were powerful, with their queen, Soniathrym, being one of the eight ancient gods, ruling the sky and sea.
target: Didicit eos potentissimos esse, cum regina eorum, Soniathrym, una ex octo diis antiquis, caelum et mare regens.

source: In the real world, encountering a true elf since the Fifth Epoch was rare, only seeing occasional descendants with diluted bloodlines.
target: In mundo reali, verum elfum ab Aetate Quinta convenire raro erat, cum vix aliquando descendentibus cum sanguine diluito conspiciendis.

source: Franca was equally shocked, blurting out, “An elf, or a half-elf mixed with humans?”
target: Franca aeque stupefacta exclamavit: “Elfus, an semielfus cum hominibus mixtus?”

source: “Half-elf,” the hoarse voice responded.
target: “Semielfus,” respondit vox rauca.

source: Though a half-elf, Howl Constantine’s features show a strong elven bloodline…
target: Quamquam semielfus, lineamenta Howl Constantine validam sanguinis elficum demonstrant.

source: In theory, the Sequence 5 Ocean Songster shouldn’t cause such changes…
target: In the theoria, Sequence 5 Ocean Songster talia mutationes non debet provocare.

source: A half-elf?
target: Semielfus?

source: Could the elves be descendants of transmigrators, living and thriving in this world?
target: Possuntne elfi esse posteri transmigratorum, in hoc mundo viventes et florentes?

source: Elf legends date back to the Second Epoch…
target: Legendae elforum ad Secundam Aetatem redeunt.

source: Franca thought deeply, almost forgetting to ask the third question.
target: Franca alte cogitavit, paene tertiam quaestionem obliviscens.

source: Gathering her thoughts, she pondered for a few seconds and asked, “Is the Lost Newins an ancient elven relic?”
target: Cogitationes colligens, paucis secundis meditata, quaesivit: “Num Lost Newins reliquia antiqua elfica sit?”

source: Though elves supposedly lived on Sonia Island in ancient times, they once ruled the seas, so leaving relics in other seas was plausible.
target: Quamquam elfi, ut fertur, in Insula Soniae temporibus antiquis habitaverunt, olim maria regebant; ergo reliquias in aliis maribus relinquere plausibile erat.

source: Yes, if Howl Constantine is a pure-blooded half-elf, it makes sense he wore a mask to disguise as a sea monster.
target: Ita, si Howl Constantine est semielfus sanguine puro, rationabile est eum larvam gerere ad monstrum marinum celandum.

source: The Church of the Lord of Storms supposedly hates pure-blooded elves…
target: Ecclesia Domini Tempestatum, ut fertur, elfos sanguine puro oderit.

source: The elderly voice in the mirror answered Franca’s third question, “I don’t know.”
target: Vox senilis in speculo tertiam quaestionem Francae respondit: “Nescio.”

source: “Alright…” Franca ended the Magic Mirror Divination and fell into a long silence.
target: “Bene…” Franca Divinationem Speculi Magici finivit et in longum silentium cecidit.

source: She suddenly regretted using Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine merely to digest the Pleasure potion this time.
target: Subito paenitebat se quod Admiralem Profundi Maris Howl Constantine solum ad potionem Voluptatis digerendam hoc tempore usus fuisset.

source: Instead of training the team and exchanging fate, they should have gotten Lumian to strike fully with their support to see if they could capture the elf alive.
target: Pro turmam instruenda et fatum commutandum, debuerunt Lumian, plenis suis adiutoriis, totum impetum facere, ut videant an elfum vivum capere possent.
